changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Execution') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[Execution] ( [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [PercentComplete] float NOT NULL, [Failures] [int] NOT NULL, ErrorMessage nvarchar(max) NULL, [StartedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [CompletedOn] [datetime] NULL, [ProcessingStartedOn] [datetime] NULL, [Processing] [bit] NOT NULL, TriggeredByExecutionUid uniqueidentifier SPARSE NULL, TriggeredByMeasureUid uniqueidentifier SPARSE NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricsExecution] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [Uid] DESC ) ) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Execution') BEGIN DROP TABLE [metrics].[Execution] END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsExecution') begin CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_MetricsExecution] ON [metrics].[Execution] ( Processing DESC ) end
changeSet.rollback: if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsExecution') begin DROP INDEX [CIX_MetricsExecution] ON [metrics].[Execution] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end
